newsitem.title: UK: British police hold Oasis star on drugs suspicion.
newsitem.headline: British police hold Oasis star on drugs suspicion.

text.p: Liam Gallagher, lead singer of British rock band Oasis, was arrested in London early on Saturday on suspicion of drug possession, police said.
A spokesman said Gallagher, 24, was arrested in the Oxford Street central shopping district and taken to a police station.
Police sources said a substance believed to be cocaine was taken for analysis. Gallagher was ordered to report back to police on December 30. He has not been formally charged.
Gallagher and his songwriter brother Noel formed the Manchester-based band Oasis and turned it into Britain's biggest pop music success story since The Beatles in the 1960s.
The band's first two albums sold 20 million copies and, on Friday, Liam Gallagher picked up a trophy from style magazine Q for Best Act in the World.
But he has had difficulty recently coping with the pressures of fame and in September Oasis was forced to call off an American tour after Liam left the country early.
The band later shrugged off reports that they were splitting and said they would release a new album next year although they would not be touring in the forseeable future.
